Boolean flag whether network a wifi hotspot.

Boolean flag where network route is valid.
LiveRouteConnectionAttempts
Number of conection attempts at the network attached end point.
LiveRouteConnectionSuccesses
Number of connections that succeeded at the network attached end point.
LiveRouteKind
Network route type: wifi (1), cellular (2).

Time when traffic measurements and statistics were recently updated.
LiveRouteBytesInCount
Number of incoming bytes received at the network attached end point.
LiveRouteBytesOutCount
Number of outgoing bytes sent by the network attached end point.
LiveRoutePacketsInCount
Number of incoming packets received at the network attached end point.
LiveRoutePacketsOutCount
